visualLanguage.ko: 검게 그을린 철과 빛바랜 청동, 짙은 붉은 가죽을 사용합니다. 잘린 모서리와 부러진 왕관 문양으로 정예를 처형하는 규율을 나타냅니다.
visualLanguage.en: Blackened rough iron, tarnished muted bronze edge bands, oxblood leather, a bold broken-crown relief, squared brutal silhouettes with clipped corners and one dull crimson enamel seam.

subjects: a heavy executioner's single-bladed axe with a broad clipped rectangular guillotine blade, diagonally displayed
a close overlapping pair of heavy squared plate gauntlets with broad knuckles and broken-crown reliefs on the cuffs, no human hands inside
one heavy signet ring with a squared bronze face bearing a broken-crown relief and a thick black iron hoop, three-quarter view, its hollow fully transparent
emblem: a single freestanding sculpted crest: a broken crown divided by a broad descending guillotine wedge, unified chunky iron-and-bronze relief, open silhouette and no enclosing plaque

visualLanguage.ko: 푸른 회색 강철과 탁한 은을 겹친 성벽 형태로 구성합니다. 넓은 수직 판과 맞물린 방패 문양이 지속 방어를 표현합니다.
visualLanguage.en: Blue-grey tempered steel, muted silver ribs, slate leather, overlapping broad rectangular bulwark plates, an interlocked three-shield motif; dense stable nearly symmetrical silhouette.

subjects: one closed greathelm with a broad domed top, narrow eye slit and tall interlocking vertical steel ribs, no head or neck
one heavy torso cuirass with wide overlapping rectangular pauldrons, broad vertical bulwark plates and a small interlocked-shield relief, no body
one wide heavy dark leather war belt forming an open oval, rectangular steel plates and one large interlocked-shield buckle, entirely visible
emblem: a single interlocked triad of tall thick steel shields forming one solid fortress-like crest; broad surfaces, open stepped perimeter, no surrounding circle

visualLanguage.ko: 닳은 청동과 황갈색 가죽에 짧은 붉은 깃발 장식을 더합니다. 앞으로 뻗은 창끝과 날개 모양 판금으로 이동과 도약을 표현합니다.
visualLanguage.en: Weathered antique bronze, warm russet leather and small burgundy pennant tabs; swept-back feather-like lamellar plates and a forward spearhead motif, light streamlined silhouette.

subjects: a close pair of light plated gloves with swept-back bronze wing-shaped cuffs and flexible russet leather fingers, no hands inside
a pair of tall cavalry boots with layered bronze wing-shaped ankle guards, pointed toes and russet leather, no legs or floor
one narrow campaign belt with a forward spearhead bronze buckle, two short burgundy pennant strap ends and fitted small utility pouch
one pendant amulet on a short complete leather loop, formed as a thick swept bronze feather merging into an upward spearhead, hollow gaps truly transparent
emblem: a single thick sculpted bronze spearhead rising forward between two swept feather-like wings with a short burgundy pennant fold integrated at the base, dynamic open silhouette

visualLanguage.ko: 밝은 철과 검은 가죽에 화염·냉기·번개를 나타내는 세 개의 작은 원석을 넣습니다. 삼각 배치와 세 갈래 이음매를 공통 형태로 사용합니다.
visualLanguage.en: Pale hammered iron, black leather, a strict triangular arrangement of three small inset stones: ember amber, icy blue, and pale lightning yellow. Three-pronged angular joints and bold triangulated silhouette, restrained magical accents.

subjects: one physical flanged war mace with a compact triangular three-fin head and one inset stone on each broad face, diagonal haft
one angular closed warrior helmet with a three-pronged crest and three small stones on the forehead, no face or body
one heavy angular breastplate with three interlocking broad chest plates and a triangular three-stone yoke, no body
one broad iron signet ring with a raised triangular face set with three different small elemental stones, visible hollow circular hoop
emblem: one chunky triskelion forged from three angular iron wedges, each enclosing a single amber, blue or pale-yellow stone, one unified open silhouette and no circle

visualLanguage.ko: 붉은 옻칠 철과 어두운 가죽을 길고 비대칭인 판으로 구성합니다. 갈라진 물방울과 흉터 같은 홈이 출혈 축적과 정산을 상징합니다.
visualLanguage.en: Deep crimson lacquered iron over charcoal leather, long asymmetrical plates, dark silver edges and a split-teardrop motif; a few broad scar-like grooves exposing red enamel, dry metal with no gore.

subjects: one large curved war cleaver with a long hooked tip and a split-teardrop cutout near its hilt, dark iron blade with deep scar grooves, diagonal
one asymmetrical crimson-lacquer torso breastplate with long overlapping plates and broad split-scar grooves on the chest, no wearer
a close pair of articulated claw-like plate gauntlets with long angular cuffs and a split-teardrop relief, no flesh or blood
one dark leather belt with long asymmetrical crimson plate tabs and a large split-teardrop metal buckle, complete open belt loop
one black iron ring with a deep-red faceted teardrop gemstone visibly split by a broad silver scar, open hoop
emblem: a single deep ruby teardrop split by one jagged dark-silver cleft, held by two sparse hooked iron prongs, a bold symbolic wound with no bodily gore or framing

visualLanguage.ko: 강철과 청동의 넓은 마디를 교대로 배치합니다. 맞물린 세 칼날 문양과 분명한 관절 구조로 서로 다른 기술의 연계를 나타냅니다.
visualLanguage.en: Alternating brushed dark steel and aged brass broad articulated segments, dark olive leather, an interlocked three-blade motif with clean mechanical joins; practical master-armorer craftsmanship, no glowing gems.

subjects: one broad straight warrior longsword with three interlocking blade-shaped brass inlays at the forte and a stepped steel-and-brass crossguard, diagonal
one practical closed helmet built from three interlocking broad steel-and-brass plates, a low triple ridge and reinforced neck plates, no wearer
a close pair of highly articulated broad gauntlets with alternating brass and steel segments and three-blade cuff stamps, no flesh
a pair of articulated sabaton boots with alternating steel-and-brass plates, three broad ankle straps and crisp joints, no wearer
one heavy amulet of three interlocking short blade shapes in alternating brass and steel, hanging from a short complete dark olive cord loop
emblem: one integrated knot of three short broad blade shapes that lock into each other, steel-brass-steel, visually suggesting a repeating three-step combo; sculpted open silhouette, no enclosing ring

visualLanguage.ko: 오래된 흑철과 상아색 뼈판에 억제된 청록빛을 넣습니다. 두 겹의 옆얼굴과 반복되는 세로 능선으로 선조의 잔영을 나타냅니다.
visualLanguage.en: Ancient black iron, worn ivory bone plates, charcoal fur trim and sparse muted teal inlay; paired ancestral profile reliefs and doubled vertical ridges, weighty ancestral craft, no living figures.

subjects: one ancient closed helmet with an ivory brow, doubled ridges and a stylized bearded ancestral mask faceplate, no human head
one ancient lamellar torso armor with broad ivory bone plates over black iron and a narrow charcoal fur collar, paired ancestor profile relief on breast, no body
a pair of sturdy ancient boots with ivory shin plates, doubled ridges and small dark fur cuffs, no legs
one thick ancient warrior belt with a paired-ancestor-mask buckle, ivory bone plate segments and sparse muted teal inlay
one sculpted ivory-and-black-iron pendant showing two staggered ancestral helmet profiles, a short complete dark cord, sparse teal inlay
emblem: a single sculpted doubled ancestral helmet profile with an ivory leading face and a recessed teal-black echo offset behind it; both merge into one bold crest, no portrait frame

visualLanguage.ko: 현무암과 무딘 황동을 육중한 덩어리로 묶습니다. 주먹과 압력 균열 문양으로 높은 자원을 유지한 뒤 내리치는 강타를 나타냅니다.
visualLanguage.en: Rough charcoal basalt slabs clamped with dull heavy brass, thick dark hide straps, sparse amber pressure-crack inlays; colossal blocky mass and a clenched-fist motif, restrained highlights, no flames or particles.

subjects: one enormous square-headed war maul made of a basalt block bound by thick brass clamps, very heavy short haft wrapped in dark hide, diagonal
one massive squat closed helmet with a basalt brow slab, broad blocky brass jaw guard and a central amber crack, no wearer
one extremely heavy torso cuirass made from broad basalt slabs bound by thick brass bands, huge squared shoulders and a fist relief, no body
a close pair of massive blocky gauntlets with basalt knuckle blocks and broad brass braces, strong clenched silhouette, no hands inside
one very broad reinforced war belt with a massive rectangular basalt fist buckle and thick brass clamp segments
one oversized heavy brass ring topped by a cubic basalt signet with a single amber pressure crack and a broad fist relief, large transparent opening
emblem: one compact raised clenched basalt fist with thick brass knuckle braces and a few amber pressure cracks, massive solid sculpted silhouette, no forearm, frame, platform, or background
